description:
Perform a residual normality check for an ANOVA analysis. 

1. Open the dataset '~/Documents/Jamovi/ToothGrowth.csv'.
2. Configure the 'dose' variable so it can be used as a Factor (change Measure Type to Nominal or Ordinal).
3. Run a general ANOVA (Analyses > ANOVA > ANOVA) predicting 'len' (Dependent) from 'dose' (Fixed Factor).
4. In the ANOVA options, enable 'Save > Residuals' to add the residuals to the dataset.
5. Run a Descriptives analysis (Exploration > Descriptives) on the newly created Residuals variable.
6. In Descriptives options, enable the 'Shapiro-Wilk' normality test.
7. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/ToothGrowth_Residuals.omv'.
